info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Payments-v4-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Payments Retrieval API allows users to fetch detailed information about utility billing payments. This endpoint provides access to payment records, facilitating financial reconciliation and reporting for service providers. Typical consumers of this API include financial departments, customer service applications, and analytics platforms seeking real-time payment insights. It streamlines the management of payment data to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

get.description: Fetches the payment details associated with billing. This endpoint allows you to view the current payment status, historical transactions, and any other relevant billing information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve payment information for billing purposes. It includes necessary data to identify the payment context and any preferences for the response format.

ListUtilityBillingPaymentsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing and payment. It defines the expected format for the request payload.
